sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: García elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Alan García beats Ollanta Humala in June's runoff, returning to power after two decades.

geopolitical_news.headline: Free-trade deal with US signed
geopolitical_news.summary: The pact is inked in April amid fierce nationalist opposition.

sport.headline: Peru misses the World Cup
sport.summary: A last-place qualifying finish keeps Peru out of Germany 2006.

geopolitical_news.headline: Devastating Pisco earthquake
geopolitical_news.summary: An 8.0 quake on August 15 kills hundreds and flattens towns south of Lima.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fujimori extradited from Chile
geopolitical_news.summary: The ex-president is sent home in September to face human rights charges.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final exit
sport.summary: Peru loses to Argentina in the quarter-finals of the Venezuela-hosted Copa América.

geopolitical_news.headline: 'Petroaudios' scandal erupts
geopolitical_news.summary: Leaked tapes of oil-contract kickbacks topple the cabinet in October.

geopolitical_news.headline: US trade deal takes effect
geopolitical_news.summary: The free-trade agreement with the United States enters into force amid nationalist protests.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying struggles
sport.summary: Peru sits near the bottom of the CONMEBOL table.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bagua Amazon clashes
geopolitical_news.summary: A June police operation against indigenous protesters leaves dozens dead.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fujimori sentenced to 25 years
geopolitical_news.summary: The ex-president is convicted in April of human rights crimes.

sport.headline: Peru misses South Africa 2010
sport.summary: A last-place finish in CONMEBOL qualifying extends Peru's long World Cup absence.

geopolitical_news.headline: García's popularity slides
geopolitical_news.summary: Corruption scandals and social conflicts dog the government's final year.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mining conflicts spread
geopolitical_news.summary: Protests over mining and extractive projects multiply across the Andes and Amazon.

sport.headline: Pizarro stars for Bayern
sport.summary: Claudio Pizarro enjoys a prolific season in the Bundesliga.

geopolitical_news.headline: Humala elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Ollanta Humala beats Keiko Fujimori in June's runoff on a leftist-nationalist platform.

geopolitical_news.headline: Markets panic then calm
geopolitical_news.summary: Stocks plunge on his victory before moderating pledges reassure investors.

sport.headline: Copa América third place
sport.summary: Peru beats Venezuela to finish third in Argentina; Guerrero is top scorer.

geopolitical_news.headline: Conga mining protests
geopolitical_news.summary: Deadly clashes over the Yanacocha gold project force a state of emergency.

geopolitical_news.headline: 'Artemio' captured
geopolitical_news.summary: The last Shining Path military leader is caught in February.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying push
sport.summary: Peru climbs the table but falls short of Brazil 2014.

geopolitical_news.headline: Humala's approval collapses
geopolitical_news.summary: Mounting corruption allegations and unmet campaign promises sink President Humala's approval ratings sharply.

geopolitical_news.headline: Spying scandal with Chile
geopolitical_news.summary: A Peruvian naval officer is accused of spying for Chile.

sport.headline: Peru misses Brazil 2014
sport.summary: A seventh-place finish in CONMEBOL qualifying ends Peru's hopes for Brazil 2014.

geopolitical_news.headline: Sea border ruling favors Peru
geopolitical_news.summary: The ICJ grants Peru a swathe of disputed Pacific waters from Chile in January.

geopolitical_news.headline: First lady's diaries scandal
geopolitical_news.summary: Nadine Heredia faces money-laundering probes over alleged illicit funds.

sport.headline: No World Cup for Peru
sport.summary: Peru watches the Brazil 2014 World Cup from home after another failed qualifying campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Tía María mining clashes
geopolitical_news.summary: Protests against the copper project turn deadly in Arequipa.

geopolitical_news.headline: Humala lame-duck year
geopolitical_news.summary: Humala's government limps toward the 2016 elections amid corruption scandals and collapsing approval.

sport.headline: Copa América third place
sport.summary: Peru again finishes third at the Chile-hosted Copa América, beating Paraguay in the playoff.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kuczynski elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Pedro Pablo Kuczynski edges Keiko Fujimori by a razor-thin margin in June.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fujimorismo dominates Congress
geopolitical_news.summary: Keiko Fujimori's party wins an absolute legislative majority, setting up clashes with Kuczynski.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final exit
sport.summary: Peru loses to Colombia on penalties in the United States.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fujimori pardoned
geopolitical_news.summary: Kuczynski pardons the ex-dictator on Christmas Eve, sparking massive protests.

geopolitical_news.headline: Odebrecht scandal engulfs elite
geopolitical_news.summary: The Brazilian firm's bribes implicate ex-presidents and top officials.

sport.headline: World Cup qualification sealed
sport.summary: Peru beats New Zealand in a playoff to reach Russia 2018, ending a 36-year wait.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kuczynski resigns
geopolitical_news.summary: He quits in March over vote-buying tapes; Martín Vizcarra takes over.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fujimori pardon annulled
geopolitical_news.summary: Courts revoke the pardon in October and he returns to prison.

sport.headline: World Cup group-stage exit
sport.summary: Peru beats Australia for a first finals win in 40 years but goes out.

geopolitical_news.headline: Vizcarra dissolves Congress
geopolitical_news.summary: He shuts the Fujimorista legislature in September, triggering a constitutional crisis.

geopolitical_news.headline: García dies by suicide
geopolitical_news.summary: Alan García shoots himself in April as police arrive to arrest him over Odebrecht.

sport.headline: Copa América final reached
sport.summary: Peru stuns Chile in the semi-final before losing to Brazil in Rio.

geopolitical_news.headline: Vizcarra impeached
geopolitical_news.summary: Congress ousts him in November over unproven bribery claims.

geopolitical_news.headline: Merino resigns after deadly protests
geopolitical_news.summary: His successor quits after five days as police kill two demonstrators.

geopolitical_news.headline: Sagasti takes interim office
geopolitical_news.summary: Veteran lawmaker Francisco Sagasti becomes caretaker president in November after days of turmoil.

sport.headline: Football halted by pandemic
sport.summary: Qualifiers stop for months; Peru resumes with heavy defeats.

geopolitical_news.headline: Castillo elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Rural teacher Pedro Castillo narrowly beats Keiko Fujimori in June's runoff.

geopolitical_news.headline: Deadly COVID waves
geopolitical_news.summary: Peru records one of the world's highest per-capita death tolls.

sport.headline: Copa América semi-final run
sport.summary: Peru finishes fourth in Brazil, losing to the hosts.

geopolitical_news.headline: Castillo ousted and jailed
geopolitical_news.summary: He is impeached and arrested in December after attempting to dissolve Congress.

geopolitical_news.headline: Boluarte takes power
geopolitical_news.summary: Vice president Dina Boluarte becomes Peru's first woman president amid deadly protests.

sport.headline: World Cup playoff heartbreak
sport.summary: Peru loses to Australia on penalties, missing Qatar 2022.

geopolitical_news.headline: Deadly crackdown on protests
geopolitical_news.summary: Dozens die as security forces crush demonstrations demanding Boluarte's exit.

geopolitical_news.headline: Government approval collapses
geopolitical_news.summary: President Boluarte's approval ratings sink to single digits amid the deadly protest crackdowns.

sport.headline: Poor start to 2026 qualifying
sport.summary: Peru goes winless through the year's World Cup qualifiers, sinking to the bottom.

geopolitical_news.headline: 'Rolexgate' scandal
geopolitical_news.summary: Boluarte faces probes over luxury watches and unexplained wealth.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fujimori dies
geopolitical_news.summary: The ex-dictator dies in September after a late humanitarian release.

sport.headline: Copa América group-stage exit
sport.summary: Peru goes out winless in the United States, finishing bottom of its Copa América group.

geopolitical_news.headline: Boluarte impeached and removed
geopolitical_news.summary: Congress ousts her in October over crime and corruption; José Jerí takes over.

geopolitical_news.headline: Election countdown begins
geopolitical_news.summary: The interim government schedules 2026 general elections aimed at restoring Peru's democratic order.

sport.headline: Peru misses 2026 World Cup
sport.summary: A dismal World Cup qualifying campaign ends any Peruvian hopes of reaching the finals.
